name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
title: Vedant Fashions Ltd - 543463 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q2 revenue +2.4% and H1 +4.8% with SSG reported negative (-5.8% in Q2) and no numeric FY guidance; management leans on Diwali-minus-30 green shoots and store openings pushed to H2, so supply discipline is the only firm positive.

summary.headline: Vedant Fashions Q2 FY27 revenue rose 2.4% to ~INR269 crore and PAT ~INR56 crore, hit by festive-calendar shift; SSG was -5.8%.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations was about INR269 crore (up 2.4% YoY) and PAT about INR56 crore (up 0.2%), with management attributing the soft quarter to Navratri moving into Q3 and a Shradh-period final 10 days of Q2. H1 FY27 revenue was about INR571 crore (up 4.8%) and PAT about INR137 crore (up 8.3%), with gross margin of about 65.3%. Management said SSG excluding the last 10 days of Q2 was positive, and that October trends (Diwali minus 30 days) show green shoots, with H2 as the expected recovery. Operating deleverage was the stated cause of lower Q2 margin, and the company is shifting towards more store-level and product-breadth initiatives.

segments.name: Manyavar (core men's wedding wear)
segments.commentary: Management highlighted Manyavar's 99% awareness in India and a wedding-wear leadership campaign, After Hours collection, and a 1% points loyalty program (Manyavar Celebration Club) launched during the period.

segments.name: Twamev (premium)
segments.commentary: Planned 30 best stores across top 30 Indian markets; 21 stores remain to be opened, delayed by build-to-suit properties taking about two years each. Flagship store opened in the quarter.

segments.name: Diwas (value festive kurtas)
segments.commentary: Management expects Diwas to cross INR100 crore revenue this year; viral Flipkart Fashion collaboration featured in the quarter.

segments.name: Mohey (women's celebration wear)
segments.commentary: About 6-7 EBOs; revenue salience just above 10% (area share slightly higher); under 1% of mid-premium women's celebration wear market share. Model is being refined before aggressive expansion.

segments.name: MBO channel
segments.commentary: Achieved 100% of Q2 budget per management; high double-digit growth targeted; SIS reporting discontinued.

guidance_outlook: No formal guidance given; management aims for high single-digit to double-digit SSG over the next three quarters, which it says is not a guidance figure.
Management expects H2 to be strong and November-December-January heavy; says it is confident of margin recovery in H2 and a good full-year margin.

Store openings: mid-single-digit fleet growth in FY27 (majority of openings in H2), similar pace next year with slight improvement, early double-digit in FY29, and high double-digit area growth in about two years.
Long-term SSG aim: high single-digit on a sustained basis; 10-year vision is to own all Indian wear.
Management said nothing active in M&A pipeline; open to Indian wear acquisitions and building an in-house evaluation team.
capex_capacity: Net addition of ~5,000 sq ft of retail area in Q2 after measured openings and rationalisation; closures concentrated in H1.
EBO count ~497 as of Sep 30, 2026 vs 508 a year earlier; retail area ~1.67 million sq ft (unchanged YoY per management).
Exclusive Twamev flagship store and one exclusive Mohey EBO opened in the quarter.
Q3 plans: nearly six collections launched; ~150 short videos for Meta and Google testing.
Twamev store expansion constrained by build-to-suit timelines of around two years per property.
demand_pricing: Festive shift: Navratri moved from Q2 FY26 to Q3 FY27, and last 10 days of Q2 FY27 fell in Shradh period, with no wedding dates in Q2 in AP/Telangana.
Management says ASP growth is returning, average basket size is rising, and repeat customers are growing well; the key gap is new-customer acquisition.
Competition: management says local and regional players are losing money and store closures are visible; internal data shows consolidation quarter-on-quarter for the last two quarters.
Retail KPI focus: AI cameras used to lift conversion in bottom 30% of stores; target 1-1.5% conversion gain per year.
Channel mix: EBOs ~90% of sales (down from ~92% three years ago, mainly due to e-commerce).

qa_highlights.question: How is management thinking about full-year SSG and October festive demand?
qa_highlights.answer: October is hard to read because Diwali moved to November; internal Diwali minus 30 days comparison shows green shoots. No formal guidance, but high single-digit SSG is the long-term aim.

qa_highlights.question: Will area addition scale up to double-digit growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Mid-single-digit fleet expansion in FY27, similar next year, early double-digit in FY29, and high double-digit growth in about two years.

qa_highlights.question: Are there margin risks given slower growth and input cost pressure?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO expects full-year margins to be strong as historically; Q2 margin reflects operating deleverage on a small quarter, with H2 expected to recover.

qa_highlights.question: What is behind confidence in recovery into FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cites ASP recovery, basket size growth, repeat customer growth, a wider product range, and competitor consolidation, with new-customer acquisition still the main gap.

qa_highlights.question: How does Q2 SSG look excluding the last 10 days?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said SSG would have been positive if the last 10 days of Q2 were removed, but declined to quantify it.

qa_highlights.question: What is Mohey's revenue salience and EBO count?
qa_highlights.answer: Mohey is just above 10% of revenue and slightly higher as a share of area; six to seven Mohey EBOs exist.

risks_watch: SSG was -5.8% in Q2; recovery relies on H2 festive trading (Nov-Jan), so monitor Q3 SSG and whether the Diwali minus 30 days trend holds.
Margin: Q2 was hit by operating deleverage and management did not quantify H2 margin recovery.
New-customer acquisition remains the stated bottleneck; monitor new-customer share and ASP.
Twamev and Diwas rollout depends on build-to-suit property timelines (two years each) and on Diwas crossing INR100 crore.
Management declined to quantify medium-term targets or M&A pipeline; several answers were evasive on SSG and date-specific trends.
summary.management_tone: Confident on H2 and the long term, but cautious on near-term numbers: management repeatedly declined to give SSG or margin figures and attributed Q2 weakness to calendar shifts. Tone was defensive when pressed on SSG (-5.8%) and on competition claims.
key_quotes: The best 10 days were replaced by almost the worst 10 days in our business from a quarter perspective.

While I cannot give you anything particular on an SSG perspective, we feel very confident, not from a guidance angle, on achieving high single-digit SSG is the target that this company aims to deliver from a long-term basis.
If we remove the last 10 days of Q2, then we were positive SSG.
Overall, when we look at H2, it is something we are very confident about, of delivering good growth.

financial_highlights.change: Positive excluding last 10 days of Q2 (per management)

financial_highlights.metric: TTM cash conversion (operating cash flow / PAT excl. finance income)

adds.what: Twamev premium stores: 21 of planned 30 best stores remain to be opened (flagship opened this quarter)
Mid-single-digit fleet growth in FY27, majority of openings in H2

growth.why: No formal guidance; management aims for high single-digit to double-digit SSG over the next three quarters (explicitly not guidance), with H2 expected to recover after festive shift and mid-single-digit FY27 fleet growth mostly in H2, backed by partial specifics (21 Twamev stores pending, Diwas to cross INR100 crore) but no firm order or capacity numbers for the SSG target.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 margin fell on operating deleverage from a small quarter, H1 gross margin was about 65.3%, and management said it is confident of H2 margin recovery and a good full-year margin, though it did not quantify the recovery.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Mid-single-digit fleet growth in FY27 with most openings in H2, 21 of 30 planned Twamev stores still to open, and a similar pace next year, though build-to-suit timelines of about two years per property create delay risk.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 customer sales grew only 2.1% and Q2 SSG was -5.8%, with the recovery resting on H2 festive trading (Nov-Jan) and ASP and basket size rising, but new-customer acquisition is still the stated gap.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation was not discussed and the company is focused on store-level and product-breadth initiatives with retail area flat at about 1.67 million sq ft YoY, so no new capex programme is signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No formal guidance is given, the SSG aim is explicitly not guidance, and Q2 SSG was -5.8%, so there is no basis for a raise in the window.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Store openings were trimmed to mid-single-digit fleet growth, Q2 SSG was -5.8%, and H2 recovery depends on the festive calendar and Diwali timing, with management declining to quantify margin recovery.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Management says nearly six collections launch in Q3 and Diwas is expected to cross INR100 crore revenue this year, with Mohey still being refined before aggressive expansion.

rows.label: Twamev premium rollout across top 30 markets
rows.why: 21 of 30 planned best stores remain to open, with build-to-suit properties taking about two years each, so openings are paced by property timelines and early double-digit store growth is targeted in FY29.

rows.label: MBO channel high double-digit growth
rows.why: MBO hit 100% of Q2 budget and high double-digit growth is targeted, but SIS reporting was discontinued so the growth cannot be independently tracked.

rows.label: AI cameras to lift store conversion
rows.why: Cameras are used in the bottom 30% of stores with a target of 1-1.5% conversion gain per year, which supports the store-level recovery plan.

tone.note: Management was confident on H2 festive recovery, ASP and basket growth, and the long term, but declined to quantify SSG, margin recovery or M&A, and turned defensive when pressed on the -5.8% Q2 SSG and competitor claims.
